maria: Quick heads-up — during quant4c bring-up of model-x (long-context variant) I saw partial token duplication after ~28k tokens when KV caching + rotary rescale are enabled. Also saw a transient cache-read latency bump. Repro command and short logs below.
joel: Can you paste the minimal repro and logs? :eyes:
maria: Repro steps:
```
./bench/infer --model=model-x:1.2.0-quant4c --seq-len=32768 --prefill=true --anchor=chat-history.txt --batch=1
```
Truncated log (gpu node 13):
```
[kv] read idx=32767 hits=1 misses=0 latency_us=2300
[kv] read idx=32768 hits=0 misses=1 latency_us=15400
[out] expected: "...the cursor remained steady."
[out] actual:   "...the cursor cursor remained steady."
```
andre: Interesting — looks like a boundary read (idx==context_window) that escalates latency and duplicates the last token. Could be a prefill vs in-flight cache handoff race. Did you try disabling rotary rescale?
maria: Yep — with `--rotary-rescale=off` the duplication didn't reproduce in 3 runs. Latency stayed ~2.3ms. With rescale=on it repros ~60% in our quick runs.
jeol: Any correlation with shard swap or model-variant routing? We had a fallback to model-x-lite on that queue at the time.
eva: Assigning provisional bisect to me. Can you add the trace flags and rerun with 3 seeds? Add `--kv-trace=idx,phase,latency --trace-samples=3` and paste the sample output.
ci-bot: CI test queued: https://ci.redwood/test/41823 (smoke/longctx/quant4c)
maria: Pasted trace sample:
```
TRACE: kv idx=32768 phase=3 rotary_phase=0.9982 latency_us=15400 handoff=shard_swap
TRACE: emit token=... cursor
TRACE: emit token=... cursor
```
andre: That `handoff=shard_swap` is a smoking gun — if a shard swap causes an async prefill then the last token could be enqueued twice when the new shard's prefill replay intersects in-flight generation.
jeol: Action items: (1) eva to bisect config that triggers swap, (2) infra to check shard-swap timing in prod queue, (3) add a guard in runtime to dedupe consecutive identical tokens emitted within the same position window. I'll open a ticket.
maria: Filed bug: INF-2179 — attached traces and repro. Marking P1 for quant bring-up. Thanks :thumbsup:
eva: I'll run bisect later today and post results. If anyone else can run the quick smoke with `--rotary-rescale=off` and confirm, that'll help.
andre: running now on test-gpu-2, will report.
maria: Thanks all — keeping this thread for updates.
